note: The levels, grouped into matches. 'matches' lists every level a match has, for the sticker album and the Match shiny. A match still being built has 'complete' set to false, so its shiny sticker waits for full time. 'cup' is the cup run on the match clock (Rich's choice, 27th November 2026): the rounds in order, each with its difficulty and its own order of moments, half by half. To add a level, add its number to the match and to every round, and add the level itself in src/main.js.

cup.note: Rich's daughter found ten moments in one match too many (Rich, 27th November 2026), so each cup match has a few moments and the skills are spread across the rounds: Round 1 is kick-offs and goal kicks, the semi-final kick-ins and corners, and the final a mix of everything, ending with the penalty to win the cup. Every level is in at least one round. 'goals' is each round's story: who scores at which moment, so the score follows the round and we always win. Levels 1, 6 and 10 always score; levels 8 and 9 score only where 'goals' says so (otherwise our corner hits the post, and their corner leads to the penalty). 'minutes' moves a moment on the match clock (otherwise they are spread out evenly). 'comeback' is the moment that goes in if a Difficult mistake let them score; their goal levels only count before it, and without one a Difficult mistake never costs a goal. 'story' lists the rules every round must keep (checked by tests/cup.test.js).
cup.name: The Cup
